shortDescription: Stacked z-levels (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP with live see-below. Pass 33 see-below input parity: render-aware right-click on buildings, elevation-lock hardening, cross-level drag-box select, targeter widening for tool targeters, and below-thing hover readout. Designators intentionally out of scope.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through** (RimWorld input is welded to Find.CurrentMap). Emerging shared pattern (pass 33): ONE render-aware hit-test (`BelowSelection.SelectablesUnderMouse` / `TryBelowRightClickCell`) + ONE input-scope adapter (`ABCurrentMapSwap` — point CurrentMap at the lower map around a read/action; plumb transform => same screen cell). Selection (in-place, no jump) + orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics; multi-frame drags are the hard part.
- **Designators are OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33):** "switch the view to that level to build/order" is acceptable. Do NOT build cross-level designators/zones/plans.
- Logistics doctrine (pass 32): every ferry MONOTONE (storage=vanilla+capacity clamp; demand=shortfall+retention via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger). Needs-bridge: postfix vanilla giver, re-run guard chain, probe linked levels, one-hop stairs job, per-pawn cooldowns. Work-migration hysteresis: post-arrival commitment cooldown, arrival-tick recharge, bumps only for level-linked maps.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7, postmortem pass 16). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12, revisit dossier pass 22).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB.

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY

## Fixes/features BUILT (green), NOT yet user-verified
1. **RMB building hit-test** (root-caused via [AB RMB diag]: ResolveTargetMap chose target level from RAW clicked cell's open-air terrain, so a below building the cursor rounded off never redirected — log showed targetL=sky on every well click). `BelowSelection.TryBelowRightClickCell` = render-aware hit-test (nearest visible pawn by rendered center, else visible building/item in cursor cell or its 8 neighbours); RMB prefix snaps clickPos onto that below cell before ShouldRedirect. Generic — DBH etc. flow through vanilla FloatMenuOptionProvider_FromThing + WrapOptions routing, NO per-mod patch. Only refines when the cheap test would NOT already resolve below.
2. **Elevation-lock GroundMap hardening:** ShouldSuppressJump keys same-column off Map.GroundMap(); if the sky map's groundMap field is null it returned null and the lock failed OPEN (RMB unaffected — keys off lowerMap/level). GroundMap() now walks the vertical links when the field is null (bounded by 3-level cap). Hardens SameColumn + 2-hop RMB too.
3. **Cross-level DRAG-BOX select** (`Patch_Selector_SelectInsideDragBox_Below`): gathers below candidates by pointing CurrentMap at the lower map + reusing vanilla `ThingSelectionUtility.MultiSelectableThingsInScreenRectDistinct` (identity transform => same cells), filtered VisibleFromAbove; then vanilla's exact category priority (colonist->humanlike->resource->pawn->selectable) over the COMBINED sky+below pool. Sky things via Select, below via AddInPlace (sky-first so cross-map dedup never wipes below). Only takes over when the box covers a visible below thing; sky-only boxes pass through. Mixed sky+below selection intended (multi-order path supports it).
4. **Targeter WIDENING** (`CrossLevelTargeting.TryHandleActionTargeter`): action-only tool targeters (DBH "connect fixture to bed", cell pickers, modded BeginTargeting(params,action) with NO drafted attackers) now resolve a below thing/cell via the targeter's OWN targetParams+validator and fire the action directly (no routing — instantaneous config), CurrentMap pointed at the target level for the call. Discriminated from the melee-squad action path by "no drafted pawns selected". Same-map thing under cursor stays vanilla's.
5. **Hover MOUSEOVER READOUT** (`Patch_MouseoverReadout_Below`): when the cursor is over a see-through cell, point CurrentMap at the lower map for the readout draw so the bottom-left panel reports the below thing/terrain. (INTERPRETED "hover thing tooltip" = mouseover readout; if user meant always-on floating labels — stack counts / owner names over below things — that's a separate render add, NOT built.)
6. **TEMP dev diagnostics still in build:** [AB RMB diag] + [AB lock diag], Prefs.DevMode-gated. STRIP after items 1-2 user-verified.

## Test-run #147 (last): confirmed the RMB raw-cell bug; lock case not exercised (no [AB lock diag] lines). All ~60+ other errors were unrelated mods.

## INTERACTION AUDIT (vanilla mouse/UI x see-below) — updated pass 33
✅ done · ⚠️ partial · ❌ out of scope
- Select: single/double/shift left-click ✅; **drag-box ✅ (pass 33)**; bracket ✅; inspect+gizmos of below-selected ✅.
- Info: **mouseover readout ✅ (pass 33, hover)**; always-on floating labels over below things ❌ not built (offer if user wants).
- RMB orders: single/multi/building(generic)/attack/formation-drag/stairs ✅ (**building hit-test pass 33**).
- Targeters: melee/ranged/ability/turret/hover-cursor ✅; **action-only tool targeters ✅ (pass 33 widening)**.
- Designators (build/orders/zones/plans/drag-area): ❌ OUT OF SCOPE per user; workaround = switch view.
- Camera: level view switch ✅; colonist-bar/alerts/letters jump ✅ (**lock GroundMap hardened pass 33**).

## OPTIONAL future (proposed, not committed)
Unify the duplicated hit-test into one BelowInput.Resolve() (kills the drift bug class that caused #1). Always-on floating below-thing labels. Targeter hover-cursor validity for action targeters over below.

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (P0-P3 done passes 27-30; P4 verify-only backlog stands). COMPAT BUILT pass 31: WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement diagnostic · light diagnostic · RMB diagnostic · below-things regen tallies.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
**0-pre (PASS 33, TOP): (a) RMB a DBH well/any building from the sky -> options appear + pawn routes down. (b) End-lock ON + click a colonist on another level in the VANILLA bar -> view stays. (c) drag a select box over the surface from the sky -> below pawns/things select in place; mixed sky+below box selects both. (d) DBH "connect fixture to bed" (or any tool targeter) aimed at a below bed -> connects. (e) hover a below building through open air -> bottom-left readout shows IT.** Then strip [AB RMB diag]/[AB lock diag].
Pass-32 queue still pending: log-carousel dead, stair-thrash dead, ferry round-2, pass-31 compat session, below lighting, animal flow, BAM/Batch B/C, perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing, P4 sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER

## Compat

## Status
2026-07-25 (33rd pass): See-below INPUT parity. Built green (unverified): (1) render-aware RMB building hit-test [root-caused via new diag], (2) elevation-lock GroundMap link-walk hardening, (3) cross-level drag-box select (combined sky+below category priority, in-place), (4) targeter widening for action-only tool targeters (DBH connect-bed, cell pickers, modded), (5) mouseover readout reflects below thing on hover. Designers-through-see-below explicitly OUT OF SCOPE per user. Temp [AB RMB/lock diag] still in build — strip after verify. Awaiting a verification test of all five + the pass-32 anti-thrash/carousel items.
